headline: The games can now play themselves — press Y
lede: WATCH landed in MYST, Emberwood and SSX: one key hands the game to its own proven solver at real speed, and any tap or key takes it back mid-play. No videos, no cheats — the same autopilot the harness proves.

notes.text: MYST resumes the proven route exactly where you stand (junction match on the solveScript walk); wander off the line and it honestly says no guide yet.
Emberwood's guide borrows the attract kit while it drives and hands your items, embers and hearts back whole when you take over — the doors it opened stay open.
SSX runs the cold witness line — the exact autopilot ssxcheck proves winnable — through all three heats; five seeded tournaments ride it to the flag in the new gate.
New watchcheck drives all three pilots in real Chrome (13/13), and mystcheck/ssxcheck/emberwoodcheck gained gates with a mutant that dies.
Slot a shipped the robot knock-recovery tail (#1570) and PLAICRAFT's recorded-play Gauntlet pilot (#1625) in the same window — both builders green.
